## NYT::NFlow::TUnitedParameters&lt;NYT::NFlow::TKafkaSource&gt; {#NYT_NFlow_TUnitedParameters_NYT_NFlow_TKafkaSource}

Source: [yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/registry-inl.h]({{source-root}}/yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/registry-inl.h)

#|
|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `topic` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Required parameter**
Name of the Kafka topic. ||
|| `finite` | **Type**: `bool`
**Default value**: `false`
Treat the source as finite: transition the stream to the completed state after reading all available messages. How the end of the data is determined depends on the connector. ||
|| `group_id` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Required parameter**
Kafka consumer group. The source commits its persisted offsets to the group on a best-effort basis, so standard Kafka tools can show the lag, and reads the group offset when a partition starts (see `use_consumer_group_offset`). The group does not assign partitions. ||
|| `partition_filter` | **Type**: `std::optional<std::vector<std::pair<int, int>>>`
Half-open ranges `[begin, end)` of the partition indices to read, for example `[[0; 4]; [8; 12]]`. All partitions are read by default. ||
|| `use_consumer_group_offset` | **Type**: `bool`
**Default value**: `true`
When a partition starts, use the committed offset of the consumer group if it is ahead of the offset the pipeline persisted. This lets an operator move a partition forward with `kafka-consumer-groups --reset-offsets`. A group offset behind the persisted one is ignored; one past the end of the partition stops the partition until the group offset is reset. Disable it for pipelines that share a group. ||
|#


{% cut "**Additional parameters**" %}


#|
|| `update_info_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `15s`
Period for refreshing the source's auxiliary partition information. A connector may use this tick for status requests and read-session liveness checks. ||
|| `byte_size_alpha` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.05`
Exponential smoothing coefficient for the average byte total and message count per offset: larger values make the estimate react to new data faster. ||
|| `update_partition_count_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `1m`
How often the controller refreshes the partition count of the topic. New partitions become new source partitions. ||
|| `metadata_timeout` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `30s`
Timeout of the metadata and watermark requests to the brokers. ||
|| `max_buffer_bytes` | **Type**: `long`
**Default value**: `67108864`
Soft limit on the records buffered in memory for one partition; fetching pauses above it. ||
